from_quote: There is to be one representative for every thirty thousand people
rationale: The paragraph names the ratio of one representative for every thirty thousand people, which is set in Article I, Section 2, clause 3.

from_quote: The representatives are to be chosen for two years
rationale: The paragraph names the two-year term of representatives, which is set in Article I, Section 2, clause 1 ("chosen every second Year").

from_quote: the right to alter the time of election
rationale: The paragraph names the right to alter the time of election, the power given to Congress in Article I, Section 4, clause 1.
